name: House Honey Mead
description:
A straightforward honey mead with a warm golden colour and a soft floral finish. The innkeeper pours it from a covered earthenware jug.

One purchase supplies one half-pint of mead. The inn retains its serving vessel; takeaway requires your own suitable container. Alcohol effects are left to the GM.

weight.notes: Contents-only weight of one half-pint of mead, using the project liquid allowance of 1 lb per pint (small spirit measures rounded to 0.06 lb). The inn retains its vessel; carried containers weigh separately.
